newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - FOREIGN DEBT $283.5 MLN AT START MARCH.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - FOREIGN DEBT $283.5 MLN AT START MARCH.

text.p: Estonia's foreign debt at the start of March stood $283.5 million, the finance ministry said on Thursday.
Finance ministry international section head Agate Dalton told a news conference that the debt figure was equal to some 5.5 percent of gross domestic product (GDP).
"Estonia will not increase the debt burden," she said, adding that some loans would be repaid ahead of the deadline.
Most of the borrowing has been done from the World Bank, the European Investment Bank and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD).
She said that during the years 1993 to 1995, loans increased by some 150 million kroons.
